name: CERT/CC (Carnegie Mellon University)
description: One of the longest-running vulnerability coordination programs, operating as an FFRDC. Over 3,500 vulnerability notes published covering 2,300+ vendors.

peerReview.processDescription: Vulnerability report reception via VINCE, Analysis by CERT/CC researchers, Multi-party coordination with vendors, Publication of Vulnerability Notes. Prioritizes vulnerabilities affecting multiple vendors or safety-critical systems.

attribution.attributionNotes: VU# entries are permanent, citable records. CERT/CC credit acknowledges researchers. FFRDC status gives endorsements significant credibility.

povsAlignment.description: FFRDC vulnerability coordination program with permanent, citable VU# records.
